description: Question answering over scanned and PDF documents: OCR + BM25/FAISS retrieval + Qwen2.5-VL (4-bit) reader

release.title: v1.0.0 - first working multimodal document RAG
release.notes:
First working version of the multimodal document QA pipeline, built on top of the original prototype.

### Highlights
- `mmrag` package and CLI: ingest PDFs and scans (PyMuPDF, RapidOCR), chunk, index with BM25 and MiniLM + FAISS, retrieve the best page and answer with Qwen2.5-VL-3B in 4-bit (fits a 4 GB GPU).
- Synthetic, privacy-safe evaluation set: 45 generated documents marked SAMPLE, 120 questions with known answers.
- Measured on an RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (4 GB): BM25 page hit@1 1.000 on PDF text and 0.967 on OCR'd scans (120 questions); end-to-end answer accuracy 116/120 (0.967) with the page image plus OCR text and also with the page image alone, about 3 s per question and 2.99 GB / 2.83 GB peak VRAM. All 4 errors are retrieval misses; the reader was right on every question where the right page was retrieved. Raw outputs are in `results/`.
- The original scripts were fixed (SyntaxError, IndentationError, missing `inputs`) and kept in `examples/`.
- pytest suite (22 tests, CPU only), ruff, and GitHub Actions CI.

### Removed
- A scanned bank statement with personal data was removed from the working tree. It is still in the first commit's history and must be purged before the repository is made public again (see README).
